biotools.summary: ezAlign is an open-source software package that converts coarse-grained molecular dynamics structures to atomistic resolution for multiscale modeling of biomolecular systems. The tool aligns a template molecule, minimizes energy, and combines molecules to facilitate more detailed simulations.
